extracted.intended_audience: NSF program officers, university administrators, researchers, and policy analysts interested in grant awards and fellowship distributions
extracted.subtask_description: A printed/digital catalog of National Science Foundation grants, fellowships, special foreign currency awards, and travel awards showing awardee (institution or individual), project/PI, program/purpose, award code, duration, and amount. The page is a historical/state‑by‑state listing of awarded funds and related annotations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Award Program / Category
rubrics_metrics.description: Section headings identifying program categories such as 'FELLOWSHIPS', 'SPECIAL FOREIGN CURRENCY', 'SCIENTIFIC RESEARCH', 'INTERNATIONAL TRAVEL', 'TRAVEL AWARD'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used to group awards by programmatic purpose or funding mechanism; examples on page include 'FELLOWSHIPS' and 'SPECIAL FOREIGN CURRENCY AWARD'.

rubrics_metrics.name: Recipient Institution / Organization
rubrics_metrics.description: The institutional recipient listed in all-caps (e.g., 'UNIVERSITY OF CALIFORNIA, BERKELEY', 'STANFORD UNIVERSITY', 'CALIFORNIA INSTITUTE OF TECHNOLOGY').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Primary institutional grantee; entries sometimes alternate between institutional entries and 'INDIVIDUAL AWARD' entries naming individuals directly.

rubrics_metrics.name: Individual Award / Recipient Type
rubrics_metrics.description:
Markers and lines indicating awards made to individuals instead of institutions, labeled 'INDIVIDUAL AWARD' followed by PI name(s) and project line (e.g., 'INDIVIDUAL AWARD
FROST, CAROL C; SUPPORT FOR GRADUATE NSF FELLOWS (SPI-8026436); 60 MONTHS $7,720').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Distinguishes awards to people vs. organizations; appears periodically within sections.

rubrics_metrics.name: Principal Investigator(s) and Project Title / Purpose
rubrics_metrics.description: PI(s) named followed by a short project description/purpose (e.g., 'REVELLE, ROGER, AND CHATURVEDI, M C; SFC AWARD ... FOR WORKSHOP ON NON-CONVENTIONAL APPROACHES TO FLOOD MITIGATION; NEW DELHI, INDIA, MARCH 1981').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides the named investigator(s) and brief description of the funded activity (research project, workshop, travel, translation, conference participation, etc.).

rubrics_metrics.name: Programmatic Purpose / Short Purpose Phrase
rubrics_metrics.description: Standard short purpose phrases used repeatedly, for example 'SUPPORT FOR NSF GRADUATE FELLOWS', 'SUPPORT FOR NSF MINORITY GRADUATE FELLOWS', 'SPECIAL FOREIGN CURRENCY AWARD (IN INDIAN CURRENCY) TO TRANSLATE FOREIGN SCIENTIFIC AND TECHNICAL LITERATURE INTO ENGLISH'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Concise statement of what the award is funding (fellowship support, translation, travel, workshop, conference support, etc.).

rubrics_metrics.name: Award Serial / Project Code
rubrics_metrics.description: Parenthetical award identifiers such as '(SPI-8166301*)', '(INT-8106630°)', '(CEE-7920722 A01*)', '(AST-8010699 A01*)'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Unique program/project codes used by NSF to identify awards and amendments; often include prefixes indicating program (SPI, INT, CEE, AST, etc.) and suffixes like 'A01', '*' or other annotation markers.

rubrics_metrics.name: Award Duration
rubrics_metrics.description: Duration expressed in months (e.g., '6 MONTHS', '60 MONTHS', '48 MONTHS', '12 MONTHS').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specifies project/award period length; often appears immediately before the dollar amount.

rubrics_metrics.name: Award Amount
rubrics_metrics.description: Dollar amounts given for each award (e.g., '$1,197,200', '$65,600', '$8,200', '$385,400').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Monetary value of the award; sometimes large institutional totals (e.g., multi-hundred-thousand) and many recurring standard fellowship stipend amounts (e.g., $8,200) appear.

rubrics_metrics.name: Currency Specification / Foreign Currency Note
rubrics_metrics.description: Explicit mentions when awards are in foreign currency or involve foreign currency (e.g., 'SPECIAL FOREIGN CURRENCY AWARD (IN INDIAN CURRENCY)', 'IN INDIAN CURRENCY AND U.S. DOLLARS', 'IN EGYPTIAN CURRENCY', 'IN PAKISTANI CURRENCY').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Indicates awards paid or recorded in foreign currency or involving conversion; relevant for Special Foreign Currency (SFC) awards and travel/translation support.

rubrics_metrics.name: Geographic Location / Activity Location
rubrics_metrics.description: When relevant, the listing includes locations for conferences/workshops/travel (e.g., 'NEW DELHI, INDIA', 'BOMBAY, INDIA', 'SRINAGAR', 'LA PAZ, MEXICO').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Shows where funded activities (workshops, conferences, collaborative visits) will occur; often part of travel or SFC award descriptions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Award Annotations / Amendment Indicators
rubrics_metrics.description: Additional notation appended to award codes or lines, such as suffixes and parenthetical notes 'A01', 'A02', 'A03', 'AOL', '*', '°', and short notes like 'A SUPPLEMENT'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used to indicate supplements, amendments, prior awards, or editorial annotations in the listing; appear frequently after award codes or project titles.
